summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatter entry and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title beside set_alt_screen, gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions. One open point: on dumb terminals control() drops the segment but set_window_title still returns True, following the spec's "True means written" rule.
